ac.ac: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes {@damage 1d10} force damage for every 5 feet shunted.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes a number of Reaping Scythe attacks equal to half the level of the spell (rounded down).

action.name: Reaping Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} your spell attack modifier to hit (with advantage), reach 5 ft., the creature haunted by Haunt Creature. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Haunt Creature
entries: The spirit targets a creature it can see within 10 feet and begins haunting it. If the target starts its turn within 10 feet of the spirit, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be {@condition Frightened|PHB} until the start of its next turn.
